explanation.purpose: Hopsql MCP configuration for Claude Desktop. Replace the command with the launcher path the installer prints (Windows: "command": "cmd", "args": ["/c", "C:\\Users\\you\\AppData\\Local\\hopsql\\bin\\hopsql.cmd"]).
features: Native query execution for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server
DBeaver SSH tunnels with jump servers, SSH agents (including 1Password) and AWS SSM hops
Streaming data export to CSV/JSON, and SQL dumps via pg_dump/mysqldump

environment_variables.HOPSQL_WORKSPACE: Custom workspace path (OS default if not set)
environment_variables.HOPSQL_PROJECT: Restrict discovery to one project (default: all projects)
environment_variables.HOPSQL_ALLOWED_CONNECTIONS: Comma-separated whitelist of connection IDs or names
environment_variables.HOPSQL_DISABLED_TOOLS: Comma-separated list of tools to disable
environment_variables.OMNISQL_*: Legacy names; still accepted when the matching HOPSQL_* variable is unset
